correctness.rationale: The exact linearization and inverse map were reconstructed. A five-point circular affine matching would yield a degree-two trigonometric polynomial with five distinct zeros, forcing all its coefficients to vanish, then zero affine slope and central source. At the centre, the three squared radii preclude affine interpolation of a strictly concave square root. Hence the seven-station linear system is full column rank for all positive depths. The explicit circle gauge and two-radius centered continuous family prove the obstructions. The saved standalone checker returned 8,296 assertions. Finite tests are supplementary, not an infinite proof.
